reviews.text: Thank you so much ❤️ Looking forward to seeing Pleurotte & Chanterelle again 🫶🏻 …

Our cat spent a week at this boarding facility and we were very happy with the experience. The premises are very clean and well-maintained. The staff are friendly and respond quickly to our questions when we contact them. We appreciated being able to see our pet regularly in the Facebook page posts. Our cat requires special care (medication) and this wasn't a problem at all. Finally, the prices are very competitive. We wouldn't hesitate to use Ami pour la vie again.

The facility looked thoroughly clean and the staff was friendly. If you are a bird owner, you can either bring your own cage or use one on site. We brought bird pellets, fresh food and snacks, which were duly given to our parrot. The prices are more than reasonable. Also, they post pictures of your pet regularly, which is reassuring. Highly recommend.
Best boarding facility for cats and other small animals. I trust them 100%.
Highly recommended!
Thank you ❤️

We left our green-cheeked conure here for 10 days and everything went very well. The place looks a bit dated from the outside, but inside it was very well maintained and clean. The owner and staff were very welcoming, professional, and accommodating, as we had the option of bringing our own cage for the birds. The rates were very reasonable with various options available. I highly recommend this place!

It's very rare to find a place to have a rabbit looked after in Montreal, so I was really relieved to have found Ami pour la vie. I had to leave Canada for a few weeks and I was able to entrust my rabbit to them with complete confidence. Everything went very well, and when I returned, he was in great shape. Thank you for your attentive service, I highly recommend them!

Very satisfied with my first experience with Ami pour la vie after entrusting them with my two ferrets! 🙂 I was able to go on my trip with complete peace of mind and receive updates through their social media. I will definitely use them again next time. …
Excellent boarding facility, they took great care of my pet during my stay!
Thank you so much 🫶🏻 …

Friends for life is a great pet boarding place that has a quite space for easily stressed pets like cats and rabbits.
I like that they considered my rabbits favorite foods and easily accommodated my cats raw food diet.
The only downside is being closed on Sundays and being charged for this day when this is the day you would like to pick up your pets.

Good pet boarding facility, except the grooming wasn't done as expected.
***update*** It turned out to be a misunderstanding; Izabelle will rectify the problem. Excellent service, thank you very much!
Excellent boarding facility! We went on holiday with complete peace of mind, and our cat Gridouce was doing very well when we picked her up. Friendly, dedicated, and professional team!

Ami pour la vie is more than just a boarding kennel, it's a family!
My Pumpkin and my Romeo (especially) were cared for with such kindness and generosity! Thank you to Isabelle who offered me support throughout her stay! Thank you also to all the staff who love our animals!!!!
Diane

I was very worried because it was my sunny cockatiel's first time being looked after by a friend for life, but they made me realize that you can trust them. The cleanliness of the place and the warm atmosphere made me leave feeling confident. A great team, thank you, happy holidays! 🎄✨️ …
These people really love animals, love taking care of them, and it shows.

Very satisfied, and so is the cat.
Thank you.
Happy holidays, Jean.
Oh yes, we are friends for life. You are caring and professional; we have complete confidence and peace of mind with your excellent care.
Thank you so much ❤️
Thank you very much 😉 …

Every time we leave Flip and Lounie in the capable hands of the Ami pour la vie team, we do so with complete confidence. They take the time to learn about our pets' routines to ensure the most positive and stress-free experience possible. The photos of our kitties on their Facebook page are always a hit. Thank you to the whole team!
A trustworthy place to leave your rabbit; the animals are treated with the utmost care.

Don't be fooled by the building's exterior: the interior is very welcoming and exceptionally clean! There are several enclosure options and services to make your pet's stay even more perfect. I've been entrusting my rabbit to them for at least three years, and it's been nothing but positive experiences. I highly recommend them!

Hello,

I am very satisfied with your excellent service. I have used your services several times for my cat, once for Ziggy and at least five times for my previous cat, Cachou! I highly recommend you and will certainly use your services again in the future!

Eliane Leboeuf
Excellent experience with Ami pour la vie, I highly recommend them! I left my rabbit Mickey for two weeks and the whole team was super friendly and attentive! ❤️❤️😊👍🏻🐰 …

I left my lovebirds with her for a month and a half, one of them while undergoing treatment, and everything went perfectly. She followed the instructions to the letter and sent me regular updates, even including photos on Instagram, which was very reassuring.
I highly recommend her; her service is reliable and attentive!
A wonderful place to board your cats! 🐈‍⬛ Billy was very well cared for and he's coming back for the holidays! I highly recommend Ami pour la vie! 😍 …
I was very satisfied with my experience. My cat isn't easy, and despite that, you managed to take good care of him and reassure me. Thank you so much for looking after my cat ;).

I had an extraordinary experience at the *Friends for Life* cattery, where I entrusted my two little cats, Coco L’Ose and Festo, for two months last summer. From the very beginning, Isabelle, the owner, was incredibly attentive and professional, providing my little darlings with a warm, safe, and loving environment. They were pampered and surrounded with such care that I had no doubt about their well-being. Coco and Festo were happy, relaxed, and perfectly content, which allowed me to enjoy my summer with complete peace of mind. Isabelle was always available to give me regular updates, answering all my questions with kindness and patience. This cattery is a true haven for animals, and I have never seen a place where cats are treated so much like members of the family. This summer, I'll be entrusting my little treasures to them again, because I know I'll never find another boarding facility that offers such a high level of care, attention, and dedication. *Amis pour la Vie* is simply exceptional, and I recommend it to all parents who want the best for their children!
Very clean and professional service
Thank you so much 🤗 Looking forward to taking care of Pumba ❤️ …
The place is clean, calm, safe, and above all, filled with love for animals. A huge thank you to the whole team for their kindness, availability, and passion!
Great! We left Peaky with complete confidence.

My experience at the cattery was simply fantastic! From drop-off onwards, everything was quick and easy, and payment was super simple too. I was able to see my cat, say a quick goodbye, and even take a peek at the other boarders. The facilities are impressive, and the cages are super comfortable and well-designed; everything is geared towards the cats' well-being. In addition to a cozy interior, the cats get to play outside in a secure room filled with toys and fun features. Picking up was just as easy. Honestly, I highly recommend it; my cat was treated like royalty, and I left with complete peace of mind ❤️🐾🐱

They truly care about the well-being of each animal. My conure freely accompanied them to the office every day. I loved being able to follow her and get updates via their Facebook page during my trip. It was reassuring!
I'm leaving with complete peace of mind, leaving my animals in Ami's good care for life 🤣 …

Welcoming
Kindness
Passionate about animals
Attentive to the well-being and needs of each client
I feel completely at ease with them!
Highly recommended!
Thank you for taking such good care of our companions!
The people are super friendly and take great care of our animals. We've boarded our rabbits twice and the service is perfect!
My chinchillas spent two weeks at Ami pour la vie. The team took excellent care of them, providing a suitable environment and keeping me updated regularly. I highly recommend them!

Ami pour la vie is our favorite place to board our three ferrets. The cages are well-suited and the staff has a good understanding of ferrets. Outings and playtime in the enclosure are also planned for our ferrets 👍🏻 …

My cat Oreo went twice and I was very happy. I regularly saw photos of him. He seemed very comfortable; he didn't seem to want to leave!
Last year, we had to leave on a trip a week later than planned. They accommodated me and extended his stay without any problems.
Oreo will be going again this summer, and I'll be able to leave without any worries.

Thank you for the three and a half months you took care of our two big furry friends ❤️ Thank you also for keeping me updated so often and for replying to my messages! We are happy to entrust our cats to you because we have great confidence in them!

Ami pour la vie has been taking care of our rabbit during our holidays for a few years now, and the service has always been impeccable and courteous. You can feel their love for animals, and the animals feel it too! I highly recommend them if you want to travel with complete peace of mind.
A huge thank you to the team for taking such good care of our ferret while we were away!! ❤️
Thank you so much!

We've been using "Friend for Life" (Izabelle)'s in-home cat-sitting services for our two cats for two years now and we're extremely happy with the service. Izabelle takes the time to play with our cats and takes excellent care of them. We go on vacation with complete peace of mind! I highly recommend them.
I had my cat, Patte, looked after. Excellent service, the staff are professional and welcoming. No negative comments whatsoever!

Great place
I highly recommend, great place and great team
Thank you for your excellent service, my Maizye was treated like a queen 👑 …
I leave my two cats in peace; the Ami pour la vie team are the only ones I trust.
Thank you ❤️
The Best in the area
I used their services to look after my two cats and I highly recommend them. They love animals and I left with complete peace of mind knowing my cats were in good hands.
chacré boooooooooooooooooooon charvise
❤️❤️❤️❤️🙏Thank you …
Excellent service from Isabelle and her entire team, thank you!
I had my cat groomed. Good work and service. Thank you.

Such a lovely place in a rough neighborhood! You feel like you're somewhere else entirely as soon as you walk through the door! The staff is super friendly. Excellent service!
We went there to have our three rabbits' nails trimmed and one of them groomed!
We'll definitely remember this place!
